files.source.svg: author source SVG (from the paper's arXiv/source bundle)
files.preview.png: PNG render of the author SVG
files.print.png: the figure as extracted from the published PDF, at print size
files.semantics.json: full semantic record for this figure

templates.why_chosen: Star, medium-confidence matrix exemplar of a 2x2 quadrant grid, each quadrant colour-coded and tied to one paper subsection number, read clockwise from the DNN model through plan-selection tradeoffs to generated device code.
templates.what_to_learn: Assign each quadrant of a 2x2 grid its own colour family and its own subsection number so the reading order is announced by the numbers rather than position alone; many similar pastel colours without a legend get hard to tell apart at this density, so keep quadrant palettes visibly distinct.
